simple.meaning: גֵּרְשֹׁם (Gêrᵉshôm) appears 14 times in the Hebrew Scriptures and is introduced as a son in the family line and in connection with priesthood.
simple.biblicalBackground: The first appearances are in Exodus, Judges, 1 Chronicles, Ezra, beginning at Exodus 2:22. BibleIQ detects the main surrounding context as birth, family, family line, firstborn, priesthood, land.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to גֵּרְשֹׁם (H1647) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: People in Scripture are understood by their place in the story. BibleIQ follows גֵּרְשֹׁם through the actual verses so the reader sees the person in context instead of as an isolated dictionary entry.
simple.summary: גֵּרְשֹׁם (Gêrᵉshôm) / H1647 is tracked through Exodus 2:22, Exodus 18:3, Judges 18:30, 1 Chronicles 6:1. The entry is generated from source alignment, occurrence evidence, and the surrounding Scripture context.

definitions.short: Gereshom , the name of four Israelites
definitions.full: H1647. Gereshom גֵּרְשֹׁם proper name, masculine 1 son of Moses & Sipporah Exod 2:22 (explanation as if from גור ) = 18:3 ; גֵּרְשׁוֺם 1Chr 23:15-16 , 26:24 ; so also גֵּרְשֹׁם Judg 18:30 מְנַשֶּׁה בֶּןֿ ᵑ0 compare VB. 2 a son of Levi גֵּרְשֹׁם 1Chr 6:1 ; 6:28 ; 15:7 (compare גֵּרְשׁוֺן ); גֵּרְשׁוֺם 6:2 ; 6:5 ; 6:47 ; 6:56 . 3 a son of Phinehas Ezra 8:2 .
